in_sanskrit.name: Evika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of love and fertility
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Evika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Evika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Evam', meaning 'thus' or 'so'. In Hindu mythology, Evika is often associated with the goddess Parvati, symbolizing love, beauty, and fertility. Her name embodies the essence of the divine feminine, representing the nurturing and life-giving powers of the universe.
